brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full cell piece:0,0,0;full with top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top, solid caps on all six side faces (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330), and the five unused port slots filled with plugs (port:0#0,0#1–#5). After this, check_build reported no open faces.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 is hex-port-louvre in port slot 0. The catalog describes it as venting a closed cell without letting rain in.

requirements.requirement: Place to mount the board inside
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi is a third-depth tray with posts at a Raspberry Pi's mounting holes, so the board sits on standoffs.

finish.summary: One-cell closed enclosure: a base, a tray with Raspberry Pi mounting posts, a top cover, solid caps on all six sides, a louvred vent in port slot 0 and plugs in the other five port slots. 14 parts; passes the checks and the parts don't collide.
